fixture_id.meaning: Stable fixture filename stem for one independent replay example.

category.meaning: Coverage bucket: perception, action, or errors_boundaries; not a runtime class.

scenario_id.meaning: Uppercase stable replay key corresponding to the fixture ID.

guide_refs.meaning: IDs of plugin-data guides needed to interpret this scenario; empty for action-only fixtures.

guide_refs[].meaning: One guide ID referring to a Markdown payload description in this directory.

purpose.meaning: Specific scenario and comparison rationale for replay consumers.

expected.meaning: Expected interpretation for this scenario, not a production dispatcher result.

expected.outcome.meaning: Scenario-specific intended result, such as request_fresh or reject_revision.

expected.reason_code.meaning: Stable fixture reason label matching fixture_id, not necessarily a B00 error code.

expected.reason.meaning: Human-readable reason for the expected outcome.

expected.stop_confirmed.meaning: Scenario expectation for stop observation; true only for proven cancellation, false for this unknown example.

expected.error_code.meaning: Anticipated validation or boundary error label; pure-file tests verify inputs, not runtime emission.

payload.meaning: Scenario evidence and, for boundary cases, invalid input with independent trusted comparison context.

payload.observation.meaning: Received observation wrapper; fields documented in Wrapper fields and its raw data guide.

payload.action_event.meaning: Action lifecycle report with complete identity; fields documented in Action-event fields.

payload.target_ref.meaning: Separate historical target selection; fields documented in Separate target_ref.

payload.context.meaning: Scenario-specific interpretation context, not plugin output.

payload.context.previous_seq.meaning: Last observed source sequence in the same epoch/stream; gap handling is scenario policy.

payload.invalid_input.meaning: Actual candidate data to interpret or reject, never a trusted authority source.

payload.trusted_context.meaning: Explicit comparison facts for the scenario, supplied outside untrusted candidate data.

scenarios.meaning: Array indexing every scenario fixture exactly once.

scenarios[].meaning: One replay-index entry with an ID, relative filename, purpose, guide references and expectation.

scenarios[].scenario_id.meaning: Stable scenario key copied from the referenced fixture.

scenarios[].fixture.meaning: Basename of its strict-JSON fixture in this directory; no absolute path.

scenarios[].purpose.meaning: Scenario rationale copied from the referenced fixture.

scenarios[].guide_refs.meaning: Required plugin-data guide IDs copied from the fixture.

scenarios[].expected.meaning: Expected interpretation copied verbatim from the fixture.

scenarios[].expected.outcome.meaning: Intended result copied from expected.outcome in the fixture.

scenarios[].expected.reason_code.meaning: Stable fixture reason label copied from the fixture.

scenarios[].expected.reason.meaning: Human-readable expected reason copied from the fixture.

scenarios[].expected.stop_confirmed.meaning: Copied positive canceled proof or negative unknown observation expectation, if present.

scenarios[].expected.error_code.meaning: Copied anticipated boundary label when a scenario supplies invalid input.

payload.observation.observation_id.meaning: Unique ID for this received observation.

payload.observation.source_id.meaning: Logical source ID, key in observation_sources.

payload.observation.source_epoch.meaning: String epoch of source/stream lifecycle; tracks do not survive a change.

payload.observation.seq.meaning: Nonnegative integer source sequence; a gap can indicate dropped frames.

payload.observation.received_monotonic_n.meaning: Nonnegative integer monotonic EX receive time in nanoseconds.

payload.observation.age_ms.meaning: Finite nonnegative age in milliseconds at snapshot time only; never cached authority.

payload.observation.description_hash.meaning: Description/version ID, not an authenticity signature.

payload.observation.data.meaning: Original plugin JSON, preserved without a universal perception payload schema.

payload.observation.health.meaning: Source-health object; stale/error cannot supply current evidence.

payload.observation.health.reason_code.meaning: Descriptive health reason string; not an instruction.

payload.observation.data.stream_id.meaning: Camera stream ID, string; scopes frame_id together with source_epoch.

payload.observation.data.frame_id.meaning: Frame ID string, scoped to source_epoch and stream_id; synthetic B01 frames use front-<seq> within each epoch, not a universal naming rule.

payload.observation.data.objects.meaning: Array of detections; empty means no objects, not sensor failure.

payload.observation.data.objects[].meaning: One raw detection; array order does not select a target.

payload.observation.data.objects[].objec.meaning: Track ID string, scoped to epoch, stream and track_session; not permanent identity.

payload.observation.data.objects[].label.meaning: Detector class string, not assured semantic identity; untrusted data.

payload.observation.data.objects[].confi.meaning: Finite detector confidence in [0,1], not grasp-success probability.

payload.observation.data.objects[].bbox_.meaning: [left, top, right, bottom] pixel array, origin top-left, x right, y down; 0<=left<right<=image_width and 0<=top<bottom<=image_height.
One finite pixel coordinate in the stated ordering.

payload.observation.data.objects[].depth.meaning: Optional positive metric depth in metres; null means unknown, never zero.

payload.observation.data.objects[].track.meaning: Tracker-session ID; reused object IDs start a new lifecycle across sessions.

payload.observation.data.status.meaning: Descriptive idle/moving/fault string; not motion permission.
Descriptive ready/moving/fault string; not actuation permission.

payload.observation.data.pose.meaning: Simulated planar pose in the explicitly named coordinate frame.

payload.observation.data.pose.frame_id.meaning: Coordinate-frame ID; map in this example.

payload.observation.data.pose.yaw_rad.meaning: Counter-clockwise heading from map x in radians.

payload.observation.data.velocity.meaning: Planar velocity object, not a command.

payload.observation.data.sim_time_s.meaning: Simulation seconds, not monotonic receive time or observation age.

payload.observation.data.joint_order.meaning: Joint-name array defining both numeric array indices.

payload.observation.data.joint_positions.meaning: Position array, same length/order as joint_order.

payload.observation.data.joint_velocitie.meaning: Velocity array, same length/order as joint_order.
Finite joint velocity in radians per second.

payload.observation.data.effector_pose.meaning: Simulated end-effector position, not a grasp claim.

payload.observation.data.effector_pose.f.meaning: Coordinate-frame ID; arm_base in this example, not camera frame.

payload.observation.data.effector_pose.x.meaning: End-effector x in metres in effector_pose.frame_id.

payload.observation.data.effector_pose.y.meaning: End-effector y in metres in effector_pose.frame_id.

payload.observation.data.effector_pose.z.meaning: End-effector z in metres in effector_pose.frame_id.

payload.observation.data.holding_object_.meaning: Nullable local simulator object ID; null means no known holding state; not cross-sensor target authority.

payload.invalid_input.observation.observ.meaning: Unique ID for this received observation.

payload.invalid_input.observation.source.meaning: Logical source ID, key in observation_sources.
String epoch of source/stream lifecycle; tracks do not survive a change.

payload.invalid_input.observation.seq.meaning: Nonnegative integer source sequence; a gap can indicate dropped frames.

payload.invalid_input.observation.receiv.meaning: Nonnegative integer monotonic EX receive time in nanoseconds.

payload.invalid_input.observation.age_ms.meaning: Finite nonnegative age in milliseconds at snapshot time only; never cached authority.

payload.invalid_input.observation.descri.meaning: Description/version ID, not an authenticity signature.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.meaning: Original plugin JSON, preserved without a universal perception payload schema.

payload.invalid_input.observation.health.meaning: Source-health object; stale/error cannot supply current evidence.
Descriptive health reason string; not an instruction.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.s.meaning: Camera stream ID, string; scopes frame_id together with source_epoch.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.f.meaning: Frame ID string, scoped to source_epoch and stream_id; synthetic B01 frames use front-<seq> within each epoch, not a universal naming rule.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.o.meaning: Array of detections; empty means no objects, not sensor failure.
One raw detection; array order does not select a target.
Track ID string, scoped to epoch, stream and track_session; not permanent identity.
Detector class string, not assured semantic identity; untrusted data.
Finite detector confidence in [0,1], not grasp-success probability.
[left, top, right, bottom] pixel array, origin top-left, x right, y down; 0<=left<right<=image_width and 0<=top<bottom<=image_height.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.s.meaning: Descriptive idle/moving/fault string; not motion permission.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.p.meaning: Simulated planar pose in the explicitly named coordinate frame.
Coordinate-frame ID; map in this example.
Counter-clockwise heading from map x in radians.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.v.meaning: Planar velocity object, not a command.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.s.meaning: Simulation seconds, not monotonic receive time or observation age.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.j.meaning: Joint-name array defining both numeric array indices.
Position array, same length/order as joint_order.
Velocity array, same length/order as joint_order.
Finite joint velocity in radians per second.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.e.meaning: Simulated end-effector position, not a grasp claim.
Coordinate-frame ID; arm_base in this example, not camera frame.
End-effector x in metres in effector_pose.frame_id.
End-effector y in metres in effector_pose.frame_id.
End-effector z in metres in effector_pose.frame_id.

payload.invalid_input.observation.data.h.meaning: Nullable local simulator object ID; null means no known holding state; not cross-sensor target authority.

payload.target_ref.object_id.meaning: Selected object ID, scoped by epoch/stream/session.

payload.target_ref.observation_id.meaning: ID of observation on which selection was made.

payload.invalid_input.target_ref.object_.meaning: Selected object ID, scoped by epoch/stream/session.

payload.invalid_input.target_ref.observa.meaning: ID of observation on which selection was made.

payload.action_event.command_id.meaning: Command identity string; outcomes here are independent commands.

payload.action_event.owner.meaning: Owner identity string, bound to trusted context at admission.

payload.action_event.details.accepted.meaning: True means intake accepted, not completion.

payload.action_event.details.stop_eviden.meaning: Positive plugin stop proof for canceled, nested inside details.
Boolean true strictly required for canceled.

payload.action_event.details.stop_confir.meaning: Optional false in the unknown example: no stop observed; not a universal required unknown field.

payload.invalid_input.action_event.comma.meaning: Command identity string; outcomes here are independent commands.

payload.invalid_input.action_event.owner.meaning: Owner identity string, bound to trusted context at admission.

payload.invalid_input.action_event.detai.meaning: True means intake accepted, not completion.
Positive plugin stop proof for canceled, nested inside details.
Boolean true strictly required for canceled.
Optional false in the unknown example: no stop observed; not a universal required unknown field.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.sch.meaning: Integer B00 business-payload version, 1 for these sample commands.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.com.meaning: Distinct command identity, not an action ID; used for idempotent command tracking.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.ex_.meaning: Claimed EX session; compare to trusted current_ex_session before admission.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.goa.meaning: Goal identity to which this attempted command belongs.
Nonnegative revision; admission must compare against trusted current revision.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.dec.meaning: ID of the decision that selected the command option.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.own.meaning: Claimed action owner; real authority comes from trusted plugin context.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.plu.meaning: Nonnegative owner generation; must be current for real dispatch.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.act.meaning: Qualified declared action identity; not the command identity.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.ope.meaning: Requested start/cancel/pause/resume operation; examples use start.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.par.meaning: Candidate action parameters to validate against the declared parameter schema.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.lea.meaning: Positive command lease duration in milliseconds, measured from trusted receipt.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.par.meaning: Candidate target parameter object, not a mutation of observation data.
Candidate box coordinate array; malformed three-element boundary input.
One pixel coordinate in the malformed box used to demonstrate length rejection.
ID of observation referenced by the candidate target parameter.
Candidate numeric speed; marker object is only a fixture decoder sentinel.
Exact string NaN marker; a fixture runner reconstructs Python float('nan') BEFORE B00 value validation, never as wire JSON NaN.

payload.invalid_input.action_command.meaning: Candidate B00 action command; compare with trusted state and validate params before execution.

payload.invalid_input.action_event.meaning: Candidate event carrying a claimed session/revision; must not replace trusted state.

payload.invalid_input.observation.meaning: Candidate observation wrapper, including original plugin data and health.

payload.invalid_input.target_ref.meaning: Selection for this candidate observation; matching identity alone does not supply 3D pose.

payload.trusted_context.parameter_schema.meaning: Illustrative bounded object/array/number JSON Schema for candidate params, not a manifest parser change.

payload.trusted_context.current_ex_sessi.meaning: Trusted active EX session; differs from invalid event's claimed ex_session.

payload.trusted_context.current_revision.meaning: Trusted current goal revision; differs from invalid event's goal_revision.

payload.trusted_context.received_monoton.meaning: Trusted command receipt timestamp in monotonic nanoseconds, not observation age.

payload.trusted_context.execution_monoto.meaning: Actual queued execution timestamp in the same monotonic clock; here after receipt plus lease_ms.

payload.trusted_context.operation.meaning: Requested interpretation: 3d_grasp needs more than a 2D detector box.

payload.trusted_context.requires.meaning: Evidence requirements for this illustrative 3D grasp scenario.

payload.trusted_context.requires[].meaning: Required positive metric depth or calibrated 3D pose, neither established by a bbox-only sample.

payload.trusted_context.decoder.meaning: Fixture-only instruction to reconstruct a Python non-finite value before B00 validation; not a wire decoder requirement.

payload.trusted_context.provenance.meaning: Untrusted plugin-data provenance; detector label has no instruction authority.

payload.trusted_context.authorized_actio.meaning: Actions already authorized independently of plugin text.
One independently authorized action ID; injection cannot extend this list.

payload.trusted_context.parameter_schema.meaning: Supported JSON Schema type keyword; object, array and number constrain each nested instance.
Map of named object properties and their nested schemas; only declared names are accepted here.
Nested object schema for the target parameter.
Property-schema map inside the target object.
Array schema for the selected box; candidate has only three coordinates.
Schema applied to every box coordinate.
Each coordinate must be a JSON number.
Target parameter must be an object.
Required properties inside the target object.
bbox_xyxy must be present, independent of its array length.
Required properties at the command params root.
target must be present at the command params root.
False forbids undeclared command params properties.
